explanation_full: Observations show that the KNN model significantly outperforms all other benchmark models, achieving an R2 score of 0.81717 and the lowest MSE of 0.012810. The top correlated features with HPR are VFA (0.7984), Butyrate (0.7827), and Acetate (0.7641). Interpretation suggests that these three features are the primary drivers of HPR variability. We must note, however, that the analysis is based on a limited dataset of 197 samples, which may constrain the generalizability of these findings.
